description: dotnet new templates for HoloNET: a one-line HoloNET API app, a full HoloNET Client app and more, each with the bundled Holochain conductor (0.7.0 and 0.7.1) or your own.
releaseNotes:
## v4.6.2 - Part of the HoloNET 4.6.2 release (every HoloNET package is versioned together): https://github.com/holochain-open-dev/holochain-client-csharp/releases/tag/v4.6.2

45 templates: every common .NET app, library and test project type (web, SignalR, MCP server, Native AOT, Orleans, Terminal.Gui, Aspire, Avalonia MVVM and cross-platform, Wear OS, Mac Catalyst, OpenSilver, Godot, WPF/WinForms/Razor/MAUI/Android/iOS libraries, MSTest, NUnit). Installed templates now keep their .gitignore.

HoloNET 4.6.1

- Reuse the persisted app-bound WebSocket listener when reconnecting. If none exists, create a listener bound to that app on loopback.
- Fix the Holochain 0.7.1 coordinator-update request encoding.
- Add bounded diagnostics for managed Linux conductor startup.

Release: https://github.com/holochain-open-dev/holochain-client-csharp/releases/tag/v4.6.1
